decisions.reason: The necessary visual-cue impact is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY requiring visible instructional text inside the field.
The source permits duplicated in-field help text but does not change the required language or wording of Danish labels and placeholders.
Retaining visible in-field help text does not change the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting during interaction.
The source specifies empty-field presentation behavior without necessarily changing the selected field architecture or editable-text mechanism.
Visible guidance when a field is empty can coexist with clearing placeholder text when the field is activated; the source does not revise the click-to-clear behavior.
The source does not change calendar-dropdown date selection behavior.
The decision about visible help text does not alter the checklist and dropdown control configuration.
The theme-color requirement is unrelated to interactive-field help-text visibility.
The source concerns interactive-field guidance, not image or table caption labels and their typography.
The source does not affect bullet appearance, alignment, scaling, or color.
Visible in-field help text does not change Enter-key bullet creation behavior.
The source has no effect on first-page number suppression or the page on which visible numbering begins.
